title: OpenET Launch Gives EROS Scientists—and Water Managers—Reason to Celebrate
authors: U.S. Geological Survey Earth Resources Observation and Science Center
lineage: Publisher or operator text. Local file preserves selected passages and research notes.

passages.locator: Opening; Six Models Add Up to One Ensemble; Landsat and Cloud Computing Are Essential
passages.note: The 21 October OpenET public opening covered 17 western states. Six models use Landsat and additional inputs to estimate field-scale evapotranspiration. The project aimed to give water managers and farmers more accessible data under water demands and scarcity. Google Earth Engine enabled regional processing.
